name: Joplin
param_style: ? positional (sqlite3 / react-native-sqlite-storage drivers); field lists, WHERE lists, ORDER BY and IN lists assembled at runtime by the models
schema_source: reconstructed final shape of packages/lib/JoplinDatabase.ts (structureSql + upgradeDatabase v1-v41) and packages/lib/services/database/migrations/42-54.ts; only the tables the queries need (AGPL: CREATE statements only)
data_scale: scale 1: 300 folders (nested, depth up to 7), 20k notes, 400 tags, ~30k note_tags, 8k resources, ~9k note_resources, ~60k sync_items, 20k item_changes, 15k revisions, ~19k notes_normalized rows in FTS4, ~1.6k items_normalized rows
visibility_note: 57k stars; desktop (Electron), mobile and CLI clients all keep the whole note store in SQLite
interest_note: FTS4 search built by a query builder (recursive notebook CTE, INTERSECT/UNION tag CTEs, ROWID IN/NOT IN, offsets()/matchinfo()), sync upload scans (NOT IN / JOIN on sync_items), an aggregating view for tag counts, and note lists on a notes table with no secondary indexes.
reach_note: desktop/mobile notes app with millions of downloads; SQLite on every client
